title: Mergen-21: Low-Cost 21 cm Hydrogen Line Radio Telescope
description: Mergen-21 is an open-source 21 cm hydrogen line radio telescope built as a graduation project at Ozyegin University. The repository contains a laser-cut pyramidal horn antenna design, a characterized cascaded RF receiver chain (about 39.5 dB gain +/- 0.5 dB, about 1.5 dB noise figure), a GNU Radio / ADALM-PLUTO SDR acquisition flowgraph, and the analysis software used to process recorded spectra. It includes first-light galactic-plane observations recorded in April 2026 from Istanbul, Turkey, showing pointing-dependent hydrogen-line detections. A Galactic rotation curve via the tangent-point method is a future goal and is not part of the released results.
